description: This Java class 'MockCPEHal' provides static methods to set various mock properties related to CPE hardware status (such as tamper, battery status, power removal) by using external helper methods to set properties and printing status messages.

classes.name: MockCPEHal
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to simulate hardware state changes for a CPE device.

methods.name: setTamper
methods.description: Sets the tamper status of the CPE device by updating the corresponding property.

methods.name: setBadBattery
methods.description: Sets the bad battery status of the CPE device.

methods.name: setLowBattery
methods.description: Sets the low battery status of the CPE device.

methods.name: setMissingBattery
methods.description: Sets the missing battery status of the CPE device.

methods.name: setAcPowerRemoved
methods.description: Sets the AC power removed status of the CPE device.
